$comment: Shared by ts/tests/adapters/claude-family-sessionlog.test.ts and tests/adapters/test_claude_family_session_logs.py. OpenClaude is a Claude Code fork; layout read from upstream source at the pinned revision. No installed OpenClaude binary was available, so there is no installed capture tier.

encoding.note: dot, space, underscore and accented letter; matches Main's installed 2.1.220 capture
NFD input is not re-normalized by the sanitizer itself; canonicalization applies NFC before encoding
astral char is two UTF-16 units, so two hyphens
over 200 chars: 200-char prefix plus '-' and base36(abs(djb2(path)))
non-ASCII hash input uses UTF-16 code units

legacyLayout.$comment: Before TWA-96 the helper read ~/.claude/projects with the '/' and '_' only encoding. A Claude Code transcript under ~/.claude must never be returned for OpenClaude.

telemetry.$comment: session.jsonl repeats message.id msg_01 across two content-block lines (counted once) and carries no cost field; gpt-5.4 pricing derives the cost.

gatewayTelemetry.$comment: A provider-namespaced gateway model has no pricing entry, so cost stays null rather than guessed.
